snippet.title: HIGH ON LIFE VR | OFFICIAL REVEAL
snippet.description:
IT'S REAL! High On Life is coming to VR. That game you spent 80 hours playing on your couch? It’s back. Except now it’s strapped two inches from your retinas.

Wishlist NOW on Meta Quest, PlayStation VR2, and SteamVR: https://linktr.ee/squanchgames

High On Life's port to virtual reality comes in collaboration with Flat2VR Studios.
__

ABOUT HIGH ON LIFE:

From Squanch Games comes High On Life. Humanity is being threatened by an alien cartel who wants to use them as drugs. It’s up to you to rescue and partner with charismatic, talking guns, take down Garmantuous and his gang, and save the world!
